services.name: Session Singing
services.text: Lead vocals, doubles, harmonies and ad-libs. Pop, R&B, Rock and Musical Theater.
services.send: The instrumental, the lyrics, and a guide vocal or sheet music.

services.name: Production
services.text: Alternative Pop, Hip-Hop, Electronic, Rock. I help shape the idea and bring in players when the song needs them.
services.send: A demo, even a voice memo, and what you’re picturing.

services.name: Mixing
services.text: Any genre. Guitars re-amped, drums reinforced, and your mix matched against the records you love.
services.send: Your tracks and a reference song.

services.name: Mastering
services.text: A master that holds up on every speaker, done by ear, with your intent kept intact.
services.send: Your mix and a reference song.
